description: Gpm3 insertion architecture mapped onto the Gpm1 active site, and C-terminal tail comparison
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
panel=json.load(open("panel.json")); maps=json.load(open("maps.json"))
a1,a2=maps["Gpm3_YEAST"]

# ---- C-terminal tail: align last 20 columns of the Gpm1/Gpm3 alignment and compare to active dPGMs ----
tails={"Gpm1 S.cerevisiae":"...PEAAAAGAAAVANQGKK","GpmA E.coli":"...GNADEIAAKAAAVANQGKAK",
       "PGAM1 human":"...GDEETVRKAMEAVAAQGKAKK","BPGM human":"...GDQEAIQAAIKKVEDQGKVKQAKK",
       "Gpm3 S.cerevisiae":"...PESAKVNAQMVRDEGFEKNP","Gpm2 S.cerevisiae":"...PESAKINAEKVRNEGFIKNP"}
print("C-terminal regions (the 'tail' whose removal abolishes mutase but not phosphatase activity, PMID 9854029):")
for k,v in tails.items(): print(f"  {k:20s} {v}")

# ---- indel architecture figure ----
ins=[]; i1=0; run=None
for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
    if x!="-": i1+=1
    if x=="-":
        if run is None: run=[i1,0]
        run[1]+=1
    else:
        if run: ins.append(tuple(run)); run=None
if run: ins.append(tuple(run))
SITE={8:"R7",9:"H8",10:"G9",11:"Q10",12:"S11",14:"W13",15:"N14",19:"L18",20:"F19",21:"T20",
      60:"R59",87:"E86",90:"Y89",98:"K97",114:"R113",115:"R114",182:"H181",184:"N183",205:"N204",208:"T207"}
sub={14,21,184,205,208}   # UniProt positions substituted in Gpm3 (non-conservative)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.45),247,0.25,fc="#CCCCCC",ec="black"))
ax.text(124,0.78,"Gpm1 (P00950), 247 aa",ha="center",fontsize=10)
for u,lab in SITE.items():
    c="#C44E52" if u in sub else "#55A868"
    ax.plot([u,u],[0.45,0.70],color=c,lw=2)
    ax.text(u,0.38,lab,rotation=90,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7,color=c)
for pos,ln in ins:
    if ln>=3:
        ax.annotate("",xy=(pos,0.72),xytext=(pos,0.95),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="#4C72B0",lw=1.6))
        ax.text(pos,1.0,f"+{ln}",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#4C72B0")
ax.text(124,1.18,"Insertions in Gpm3 relative to Gpm1 (56 aa total, no deletions)",ha="center",fontsize=10,color="#4C72B0")
ax.set_xlim(-8,262); ax.set_ylim(0.0,1.32); ax.axis("off")
ax.text(0,0.15,"green = position identical in Gpm3,  red = non-conservative substitution in Gpm3",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame(ins,columns=["after_Gpm1_UniProt_pos","insertion_length"]).to_csv("gpm3_insertions.csv",index=False)
print("\nInsertions >=3 aa:", [i for i in ins if i[1]>=3])
